QuestInfo.2:
Your ominous feeling... proved true.

The Xuanshan School was in ruins upon your return.
Its once proud buildings were reduced to rubble, and many of your fellow pupils laid dead on the ground. And... and the master...
Just what was that energy that you could feel around you? Are you truly Wu Shen after all...?
